notes.title: The HIVE Update
notes.notes:
-Added new wave variation that spawns after wave 5.
-New enemies: The HIVE - fast moving creature dead-set on eating you, so watch your back.

notes.title: Buystation Music Update
notes.notes: Every Buystation has its own 1950's style jingle to add flair and recognizability.

notes.title: Hard Rounds Update
notes.notes:
-Added hard rounds starting on wave 30
-tweaks to "town" map

notes.title: Atmosphere and wave variety update
notes.notes:
-added new entities scattered around each level: 
The Tormented- humans whose physical bodies are frozen in time but their souls remain in endless suffering

-added new wave variation that will randomly occur: 
the clock chime will have a lower pitch and a new enemy variant called the "Voidwalkers" will be the only enemies to spawn for 1 wave

-bug fixes

notes.title: New Enemy Update
notes.notes: New enemy: fire zombie that sprints at player

notes.title: New Enemies Update
notes.notes:
ADDED 2 NEW ENEMIES
-Nightcrawler: large crawling mutant that will stop at nothing to kill you
-Mimic: Uncanny human-like figure that mimics the human voice and calls for help. Do NOT let it trick you.

notes.title: New Frenzy Map Update: Safehouse
notes.notes:
-Added new frenzy map: safehouse
-replaced slow zombie with more realistic models and animations
-added simple sprint and aim anims for pistol

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: -enemies stop turning toward player after death

notes.title: Starter Pistol Update
notes.notes:
-You now start with a pistol and have to buy the AK
-New round start sound effect

notes.title: NEW MODE: FRENZY update
notes.notes:
NEW MODE: Frenzy - endless chaos in a cramped locker room
-added new death and attack animations
-expanded zombie audio (added more variety in sound effects)

notes.title: Gameplay tweaks UPDATE
notes.notes:
- improved wave spawn system for longer match duration
- increased entity movement speed

notes.title: Office Map and Buy system UPDATE

-added buy system to prolong player survival
